why: ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 (Charts doctrine, v3-expr-1-doctrine, Issue 964) says primitive-bypass denies data-mapped marks, SVG or HTML, drawn outside the geometry seam, and notes that until the seam exports ship the rule keeps its `svg-data-marks` form. The seam ships in v3-expr-1-seam as `useChartFocus` (`focus.target`, `focus.item(i)`) and `chartLabels` on ./charts. Left alone, the rule would deny the marks the doctrine now permits and miss the HTML form it names. The owner's note on the seam Spec verdict made this a row that gates v3-freeze-g4, so the rule and the doctrine agree when the API freezes.
what: primitive-bypass: exempt data-mapped marks wired through the seam, and add the HTML form. Rule code, one fixture and one fix message per form, tests. No new ./charts export.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/test/fixtures/lint/import-bypass/{svg-data-marks,html-data-marks}*.tsx and the seam-wired counterparts beside them
the lint form count and the generated rule docs that list the primitive-bypass forms
must_not_touch: docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md (the doctrine is v3-expr-1-doctrine's; this row makes the rule match it)
change: (1) Exempt: an element in the data-mapped svg-data-marks form that spreads `focus.item(i)` inside a container that spreads `focus.target`, where `focus` is the result of `useChartFocus(...)`, is legal; the same element outside such a container still reports. Marks inside `CartesianChart` marks stay as the rule treats them today. (2) HTML form: a `div` or other intrinsic element whose `style` sets `width`, `height`, `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom` from a datum inside a `.map` callback (a datum's share, e.g. `${d.share * 100}%`) reports, unless it is wired through the seam as in (1). (3) One fix message per form, each naming the seam (`useChartFocus` and `chartLabels` from basalt-ui/charts) and, for the HTML form, `BarList` in basalt-ui/cards for a share bar. The lint form count is 58 at most (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3): the HTML form is one form; if the count would pass 58, report it, never raise it. Each form gets a red fixture and a green fixture (the seam-wired mark). Read the final export shape of `useChartFocus` in packages/basalt-ui/src/charts after v3-expr-1-seam merged; match what shipped, not this text.
commits: One feat: commit for the rule, scope empty, no attribution.
proof: make check; the red and green fixtures per form.
acceptance: A data-mapped svg mark spreading focus.item(i) inside a container spreading focus.target from useChartFocus is green; the same mark without the container is red (fixtures)
An intrinsic element sized or positioned by a datum's share inside a map callback is red with a message naming the seam; the seam-wired form is green (fixtures)
Each form has one fix message and one fixture, and the lint form count stays at or under 58
ARCHITECTURE.md section 8's text on what primitive-bypass denies is true of the rule as shipped
out_of_scope: Editing ARCHITECTURE.md or the doctrine; any new ./charts export; static artwork (an icon, a fixed grid) stays legal; other primitive-bypass forms.
